{{Money|8,000}} on death (Voidcore) |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |fly = No |ghost = {{Attr|Ghost|Yes}} |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Soul''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It is a stronger version of the [[Soul]], having higher health than it but slower speed. It being a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy means towers need hidden detection to target it and units cannot collide with it. It also has the [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to stall. ==Logbook Description== "''Elite Souls are regular Souls of those who died from either having their realm destroyed by the Void or by succumbing to the eternal nothing. Elite Souls are created from the regular souls having found enlightenment. Basically, a higher purpose for their recreation as a servant to the Void Caster. For their loyalty, she will grant them the unique gift of wings. Sometimes, the Elite Souls will flutter their wings as a sign of joy. If there is a group of them, they then just sound like a group of angry pigeons.''" ==Appearance== The '''Elite Soul''' has a translucent white body with no legs and pink wings on its back it uses to float above the path. Above its head it has a giant floating purple halo. It wears a white, purple and black robe that covers most of its body. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS and hidden detection, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] and [[Turret]] are recommended against the '''Elite Soul'''. **Towers without it can also be used but only if given hidden detection through for example the [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Firework Technician]]. *Due to it being a [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy, units cannot collide with it, reducing the effectiveness of certain units like the [[Riot Guard]] or making them entirely useless against it like the [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Hallow Guard]]. **This however does not mean units are completely useless against it, as they can still target it with their ranged attacks, making units like the [[Rifleman]] or [[Tommy Goon 2]] better than it as they cannot die to the '''Elite Soul''' colliding with them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Elite Soul''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EliteSoulIconIG.png|'''Elite Soul''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Elite Soul''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Elite Soul''' added, replacing the [[Soul Boss]]. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health increased from 22,222 to 25,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. {{Hardcore|[[Vindicator]]|Wave 40|Elite Soul, [[Unknown Boss]] & [[Heavy Voidling]]|Wave 41|[[Void Knight]] & [[Void Trickster]]|Wave 42}} {{Voidcore|[[Crystalian]]|Wave 40|[[Soul]] & Elite Soul|Wave 41|[[Void Trickster]] & [[Nightshade]]|Wave 42}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
